claims.statement: Main window creation loads persisted UI state (ui-state.json), applies restored bounds/maximization, and tracks/re-saves window state on move/resize/maximize via window-state.ts and window-state-core.ts.
Renderer load failures/crashes are caught by window-load-failure.ts and renderer-crash-recovery.ts, and a window that fails to appear is retried by window-show-fallback.ts.
The app menu (menu.ts) sends menu commands to the renderer via <menu:event>, and the preload replays them with EarlyEventReplay; the tray and badge reflect running Host/session counts.
acquireSingleInstanceLock (single-instance.ts) returns false when the lock is already held (now-holding process exits) and focuses/restores the existing window on second-instance.
Deep links use the pi-agent-desktop: scheme with host session or path /session/<id> to resolve a sessionId (deep-link.ts); the custom protocol is declared in electron-builder.yml.
main.ts tracks a startup readiness machine and accepts --validate-packaged-startup and --validate-packaged-cleanup-fault flags in packaged builds for headless self-validation.
UpdateManager (update-manager.ts) is a phase state machine with automatic checks (initial 60s delay, 6h interval, jitter), a 15-minute download watchdog, and closed UpdateErrorCode classification.

installUpdate() is gated on no active agent sessions (installBlockedByActiveSessions) and runs the prepareToInstall hook for managed-process cleanup; on failure recoverFromInstallFailure restores the app without launching the installer.

The update adapter (update-adapter.ts) only publishes when the updater verifies a signature (SHA-512 in latest.yml), and main.ts creates the adapter only in packaged builds on supported platforms (or PI_DESKTOP_TEST_UPDATER dev mode).

redactUpdateError scrubs home paths, bearer/basic tokens, GitHub tokens, authorization headers, query secrets, e-mail addressesaging, and Users/home/tmp paths before updater errors reach logs, capped at MAX_ERROR_DETAIL_LENGTH.
packaged-cleanup-fault-validation.ts provides a headless mode proving update-install fails closed when managed-process cleanup is uncertain.
